name: UI Layer
description: Tkinter desktop GUI providing the tuner, songs, and chart tabs for real-time practice feedback.

name: Audio Processing
description: Real-time pitch detection via YIN algorithm and tuner smoothing/display logic for live instrument feedback.

name: Prep Pipeline
description: Offline song preparation stages — ingest, Demucs stem separation, Basic Pitch transcription, chart building, and background job orchestration.

name: Data & Storage
description: Central file-access layer managing the song folder layout, atomic JSON reads/writes, and the package entry point.

name: Tests
description: Pytest suite covering unit tests for audio, chart guarantees, store, and integration tests for the full prep pipeline.

name: Test Fixtures
description: JSON fixture files defining the handoff data shapes for chart, notes, song metadata, played events, and session scores used across tests.

name: Documentation
description: Architecture spec, module handoff contracts, feature specs, and project overview guiding the offline instrument practice app design.

name: Configuration
description: Project build metadata, Python version pin, and Git line-ending settings for cross-platform development.
